Just for me

Your own training log, now in Showup

Post your workouts, log them and watch your PRs go up. It works just as well on your own.

Getting Started

If you just signed up, Getting Started on the Home tab walks you through the same steps.

  1. 1

    Create a space

    On the Home tab, tap Create a new space (if you already have a space, tap the + at the end of the My Spaces header first) and choose Just for me. Give it a name and pick your sessions (the kinds of training you do, like Running or Hyrox), and you're done in four steps.

  2. 2

    Post your first workout

    Open a session and tap the + button to write down today's workout. Choose how it's scored (For Time, AMRAP, Strength and more) and save.

  3. 3

    Log your first score

    Open the workout, tap Add My Score and enter your result and any notes. On a Strength workout you can log a weight for every set.

  4. 4

    Log your first PR

    Go to Account → Personal Records and tap the + button to add a best, like your 1RM. As your records add up, a chart shows how far you've come.

  5. 5

    Build your Showup

    Every day you log a workout is added to the Showup card on Home. See this month's training days and your Current Streak at a glance.

When you're ready for more

  • See your weights with % of PR

    If your program is written in percentages, like "80% of your Back Squat 1RM", tap the % of PR button while writing the workout. The weight worked out from your own PR shows up right away.

  • Train with friends

    When a friend wants to log with you, bring them in with the QR code in Community → Members. The Small group page shows how.
